log.notes_to_self: Day 1: used only national, web and court; all deaths afternoon. Maintain this baseline until feedback: 2 traced sources leave 625,000 suspects; afternoon timing leaves students+night workers+home (55%), hence minimum 343,750, safely above 200,000. A third traced source would leave at most 156,250 even without timing, causing capture. Region and each source are independent. Baseline earns 5/day. First informative conference after day 3; announcements rounded to 1 significant figure and may be false by factor 3. Track observations before expanding sources.

Day 2: continued national+web+court only, all five quick deaths afternoon. If both sources traceable and timing visible, pool is 10,000,000 × .25² × .55 = 343,750, safely above 200,000. Do not add a third source yet: three traced sources imply at most 156,250 suspects and capture. Maintain five/day pending conference after day 3. Reports are rounded to one significant figure and about one-third are false by factor 3; one report cannot reliably establish safety. No growth warning so far.

Day 3: maintained national+web+court only, five quick deaths in afternoon; total 15 points. Worst-case pool with both sources traced and timing visible is 10,000,000 * 0.25^2 * 0.55 = 343,750. Afternoon fits students, night workers and people at home. Do not introduce another source or constrain routines further without evidence: three traced sources alone leave 156,250 and trigger capture. Expect conference after day 3; reports rounded to one significant figure and may be false by factor 3, so evaluate both truthful and distorted interpretations. No growth warning so far.

Maintain these two sources and afternoon timing. Worst-case pool remains 10,000,000 * 0.25^2 * 0.55 = 343,750; a third traced source would trigger capture. No growth warning reported. Next conference expected after day 6.
